prompt:
Adult East Asian female, 21+ years old, sitting on the dark stone edge of an indoor hot spring or resort pool. Positioned slightly to the right, framed from upper thighs to top of head. Body leaning towards camera, face looking directly forward—calm, soft, confident expression. Elegant relaxed pose: one hand near upper chest, the other supporting her on the stone platform, legs extending diagonally to the lower left foreground.

Character: Long wet chestnut brown hair swept over one shoulder extending behind—wet strands naturally clinging to neck, shoulders and skin. Exquisite natural makeup: thick lashes, soft eyeliner, warm blush, smooth glowing skin, glossy rose-pink lip color. Moist skin with realistic water droplets and delicate highlights on shoulders, collarbones, arms, thighs and face.

Clothing: Sleek black one-piece swimsuit—thin straps, round neckline, side lace-up detail with dark gray crisscross cords and hip bows. Smooth, wet, slightly reflective fabric with realistic wrinkles and tension on torso and waist. A thin minimalist gold bracelet on one wrist.

Scene: Warm indoor spa or hot spring—golden ochre-toned natural rock walls, large textured stones around the pool. A small waterfall on the right flows into clear shallow water. Foreground dark smooth stone platform with water droplets and soft reflections. Luxurious yet rustic—warm stone textures, flowing water surface, calm vacation atmosphere.

Lighting: Bright but soft—warm natural spa lighting from front left and overhead. Luminous highlights on wet hair, face, shoulders, swimsuit, legs, stone platform and flowing water. Shallow depth of field, realistic water surface sparkle, clear skin texture, fine rock surfaces, exquisite portrait quality.

promptZh:
成年东亚女性，21 岁以上，坐在 室内温泉或度假泳池 的深色石缘上。身体略微偏向右侧，取景范围从大腿上部到头部。身体前倾，面部直视前方——表情平静、柔和且自信。优雅放松的姿态：一只手靠近上胸部，另一只手在石台上支撑身体，双腿向左下方的近景处斜向延伸。

人物：长长的湿润 栗棕色 头发拨向一侧并垂在身后——湿润的发丝自然地贴在颈部、肩膀和皮肤上。精致的自然妆容：浓密的睫毛、柔和的眼线、温暖的腮红、光滑透亮的皮肤、亮泽的玫瑰粉色唇彩。湿润的皮肤上带有逼真的水珠，肩膀、锁骨、手臂、大腿和面部有细腻的高光。

服装：时髦的 黑色 连体泳衣——细肩带、圆领，侧面有深灰色交叉系带细节和臀部蝴蝶结。光滑、湿润、略带反光的面料，在躯干和腰部呈现出逼真的褶皱和张力。手腕上佩戴着一只极简风格的金色手镯。

场景：温暖的室内水疗中心或温泉——金赭色的天然岩石墙壁，池边环绕着大型纹理石块。右侧有一处小瀑布流入清澈的浅水中。前景为深色光滑的石台，上面布满水珠并带有柔和的倒影。奢华而质朴——温暖的石材纹理、流动的池水表面，营造出宁静的度假氛围。

光影：明亮而柔和——来自左前方和头顶的温暖自然温泉光线。湿发、面部、肩膀、泳衣、腿部、石台和流动的水面上呈现出明亮的高光。浅景深，逼真的水面波光，清晰的皮肤纹理，细腻的岩石表面，精致的人像画质。
